mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_favorites (user_num, mk_num, mf_name) VALUES ( #{userNum}, #{mkNum}, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(f.fo_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM meal_detail d JOIN food f ON d.fo_num = f.fo_num WHERE d.mk_num = #{mkNum} ) )
mapper.select: SELECT l.mk_num, l.mk_image as Mk_image, DATE_FORMAT(l.mk_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as mk_date, DATE_FORMAT(l.mk_created_at, '%H:%i') as mk_time, SUM(d.md_kcal) as totalKcal, GROUP_CONCAT(f.fo_name SEPARATOR ', ') as foods, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meal_favorites WHERE mk_num = l.mk_num) as isFav FROM meal_log l LEFT JOIN meal_detail d ON l.mk_num = d.mk_num LEFT JOIN food f ON d.fo_num = f.fo_num WHERE l.user_num = #{userNum} GROUP BY l.mk_num ORDER BY l.mk_created_at DESC

SELECT f.mf_num as Mf_num, f.mf_name as Mf_name, l.mk_image as Mk_image, l.mk_num as Mk_num, IFNULL(SUM(d.md_kcal), 0) as TotalKcal, GROUP_CONCAT(fd.fo_name SEPARATOR ', ') as FoodListStr FROM meal_favorites f /* 🌟 여기서 meal_log와 연결합니다! */ INNER JOIN meal_log l ON f.mk_num = l.mk_num LEFT JOIN meal_detail d ON l.mk_num = d.mk_num LEFT JOIN food fd ON d.fo_num = fd.fo_num WHERE f.user_num = #{userNum} GROUP BY f.mf_num
